2607.28956.title: MerchantBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Long-Term Coherence in E-Commerce Operations
2607.28956.paper_summary: Large language model agents are increasingly evaluated as autonomous tool users, yet most benchmarks focus on bounded tasks with immediate success criteria. Real-world deployments often require Long-Term Coherence, the capacity to preserve purposeful behavior across extended horizons while adapting decisions to accumulated evidence. Evaluating this capacity requires a persistent environment in which actions constrain future choices, feedback arrives at heterogeneous delays, and incoherent behavior produces measurable cumulative effects. Seller-side e-commerce provides a suitable setting for this evaluation through recurrent and interdependent decisions over Product Sourcing, Listing and Pricing Control, Cash-Flow Management, and Mixed-Latency Feedback Adaptation. We introduce MerchantBench, a 365-day order-level simulation grounded in 98,843 real e-commerce product records and equipped with 26 tools for agent interaction. MerchantBench couples promptly observable Upstream Supplier Events with delayed Downstream Order Outcomes, requiring agents to follow individual order lifecycles and revisit earlier decisions. We evaluate eight LLMs under two agent frameworks in 48 runs, each spanning 365 simulated days. Our results reveal a substantial gap between even the latest LLMs and human participants, with the best LLM configuration attaining only 27.3\% of the mean final net assets achieved by human participants.
2607.28956.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型代理人越來越多地被評估為自主工具使用者，然而大多數基準測試專注於有界任務及其即時成功標準。現實世界的部署通常需要長期一致性，即在延長的時間範圍內保持有目的的行為，同時根據累積的證據調整決策。評估這種能力需要一個持久的環境，其中行動限制未來的選擇，反饋以異質的延遲到達，而不一致的行為產生可測量的累積效果。賣方電子商務提供了一個適合此評估的環境，通過對產品採購、上架和定價控制、現金流管理以及混合延遲反饋適應的重複和相互依賴的決策。我們介紹了MerchantBench，一個基於98,843個真實電子商務產品記錄的365天訂單級模擬，並配備26個工具供代理人互動。MerchantBench將可立即觀察的上游供應商事件與延遲的下游訂單結果結合起來，要求代理人遵循個別訂單的生命週期並重新考慮早期的決策。我們在48次運行中評估了八個大型語言模型，這些運行每次跨越365個模擬天。結果顯示，即使是最新的大型語言模型與人類參與者之間也存在顯著差距，最佳的大型語言模型配置僅達到人類參與者所獲得的平均最終淨資產的27.3%。
